subject: Request: Manual kickstart voucher for BrightApps PLG account
raw_messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightapps.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart voucher request for PLG onboarding

Hi Grace,

Quick note from BrightApps — we signed up a small PLG cohort (internal trial pool) and want to make sure a few power users get a larger starter bundle to actually evaluate model costs. Can Redwood manually issue a one-off kickstart voucher we can distribute to three early users?

What we need:
- Single-use promo code good for $1,000 credit (applies to hosted usage).
- Expiration: 30 days from issuance.
- Max redemption per code: 1 account; we only need one code for now.
- Billing contact: procurement@brightapps.io (I copied them).

Our CSM asked whether this requires sales approval — figured I'd ask directly to avoid back-and-forth. If you need an official PO or anything, let me know. Attaching a short request summary.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director of Growth | BrightApps
liam@brightapps.io
+1 415-555-0191

Attachment: BrightApps_kickstart_request_20270324.pdf (pdf)

From: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kickstart voucher request for PLG onboarding

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Liam's ask from BrightApps (attached). They want a one-off $1k manual voucher to seed onboarding for power users.

Quick context: BrightApps is a growing PLG account; this is a low-friction one-code request to help conversion. No signed contract yet, just self-serve to paid ramp. We typically approve these under playbook up to $1k, but wanted to check accounting tagging and any limit we should set on redemption and tracking.

Can Sales Ops generate the code and confirm HubSpot activity gets updated (DL-2027-0871)? If approved, please generate an alphanumeric code, add redemption limits, and return it to me so I can send to the customer.

Also suggest attaching a short PDF voucher we can send externally with redemption instructions.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise SDR Lead | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Grace — good to proceed. Approving a one-off $1,000 kickstart voucher for BrightApps.

Ops notes for generator:
- Code length: 12 chars, format: KICK-BA-XXXX (use uppercase).
- Value: $1,000 (USD), apply to hosted API token usage.
- Expiration: 30 days after issuance.
- Redemption limit: single use; restrict to one account ID.
- Mark HubSpot deal DL-2027-0871 with activity type "Voucher Issued".
- Tag internal accounting: acct-credit-2027-q1, reference DL-2027-0871.

Marissa — can you or Sales Ops create the code and attach the voucher PDF (simple one-page) and confirm when live so Grace can send? If you want me to sign off on the final PDF, I can review.

Ben Carter
Head of PLG Growth | Redwood Inference
